title: Step 4: Visualizing Apriori Algorithm Results for Product Deals in Python

cues.en: -: Hello my friends.
cues.zh: 講師：朋友們，大家好。

cues.en: Alright, here we are, at the final very exciting step of this implementation where we visualize the results.
cues.zh: 現在來到實作最後、非常精彩的步驟：把結果顯示出來。

cues.en: So we're gonna clearly visualize the rules and see for each of them, you know, their support, their confidence, and their lift.
cues.zh: 我們會清楚看到規則，以及每條規則的支持度、信賴度和提升度。

cues.en: And mostly we're gonna see which are gonna be the best deals.
cues.zh: 最重要的是，找出最佳優惠。

cues.en: Buy one product and get another one for free.
cues.zh: 買一項產品，免費送另一項。

cues.en: We'll clearly see which food goes well with some other food, for these French people in the South of France.
cues.zh: 會清楚看到，對法國南部的人來說，哪些食物適合搭配哪些食物。

cues.en: Okay. So, let's do this.
cues.zh: 好，開始吧。

cues.en: We already have the rules here, which were the output of this a priori function.
cues.zh: 已經有了規則，也就是 apriori 函式的輸出。

cues.en: So you will see that it will be very simple to display them.
cues.zh: 你會發現顯示它們非常簡單。

cues.en: Therefore, let's select debt sale in order to create a new coat sale just below.
cues.zh: 選取這個儲存格，在下方建立新的程式碼儲存格。

cues.en: And indeed, in order to have a first look at these rules, well we simply need to create a new variable, which we're gonna call result, you know, the results of this a priori model,
cues.zh: 要初步查看規則，只需要建立新變數，叫 results，也就是 Apriori 模型的結果，

cues.en: which are nothing else on the rule, but see what I'm gonna do, I'm going to set this result variable as a list of the rules,
cues.zh: 其實就是規則；看我怎麼做，把 results 設為規則的串列，

cues.en: which will just put these rules into a list.
cues.zh: 把這些規則放進串列。

cues.en: Right? As simple as that, we just want to have our rules into a list so that then, when we display the results, you know, by just calling this variable and executing this cell,
cues.zh: 就是這麼簡單，只想把規則放進串列，接著顯示結果時，直接呼叫這個變數並執行儲存格，

cues.en: indeed we will get, in the output, all our rules in this list.
cues.zh: 就會在輸出中得到串列內所有規則。

cues.en: You recognize the square brackets here, and at the end as well.
cues.zh: 你認得這裡以及最後的方括號。

cues.en: Alright? So all these rules are listed one by one, you know, in different rows.
cues.zh: 所有規則逐一列在不同列。

cues.en: Alright? So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: These are all the rules, you know, all the rules following these criteria - a minimum support of 0.3%, a minimum confidence of 0.2, a minimum lift of 3,
cues.zh: 這就是所有符合條件的規則：最低支持度 0.3%、最低信賴度 0.2、最低提升度 3，

cues.en: and of course, two products in the rules.
cues.zh: 而且規則有兩項產品。

cues.en: You know, one on their left and one on the right.
cues.zh: 左邊一項，右邊一項。

cues.en: Alright, So let's have a look at them one by one, starting with the first one. So that's the first rule here.
cues.zh: 從第一條開始逐一看看，就是這裡。

cues.en: And what do we see? Well, I'm just going to, you know, highlight it. Alright?
cues.zh: 看到什麼？我把它反白，好嗎？

cues.en: So that's the first rule. Alright, So let's see.
cues.zh: 這是第一條規則，來看看。

cues.en: First we see that the two products in this rule are light cream and chicken.
cues.zh: 先看到規則中的兩項產品是低脂鮮奶油和雞肉。

cues.en: But be careful - the order is not if customers buy light cream, then they will buy chicken.
cues.zh: 但要注意，順序不是顧客買低脂鮮奶油，就會買雞肉。

cues.en: No, it's actually the other way around because, indeed, if we scroll to the right, well that's important.
cues.zh: 不，其實反過來；往右捲，這點很重要。

cues.en: You see items base is equal to light cream, and then items add is equal to chicken.
cues.zh: 看到 items_base 等於 light cream，items_add 等於 chicken。

cues.en: So that means that actually the left hand side of the rule is light cream, and the right hand side of the rule is chicken. Okay?
cues.zh: 所以規則左側其實是低脂鮮奶油，右側是雞肉，好嗎？

cues.en: So that means that if people buy light cream, then they will have a high chance to buy chicken, and that high chance is actually measured by the confidence, which is 0.29 here.
cues.zh: 表示買低脂鮮奶油的人，很有機會買雞肉；這個機率用信賴度衡量，這裡是 0.29。

cues.en: So that means that if customers buy light cream, then they will have 29% chance of buying chicken, which makes sense, right?
cues.zh: 也就是顧客買低脂鮮奶油後，有 29% 的機會買雞肉，這很合理，對吧？

cues.en: Well, at least in France because usually French people love to put some nice light cream with lemon as a sauce for their chicken, right?
cues.zh: 至少在法國是如此，因為法國人通常喜歡把低脂鮮奶油和檸檬做成雞肉的醬汁。

cues.en: It's a common traditional French meal.
cues.zh: 這是常見的法國傳統料理。

cues.en: I actually really enjoy it myself. Alright?
cues.zh: 我自己也很喜歡，好嗎？

cues.en: And then we can also see the lift, which is a very good one, 4.84.
cues.zh: 還能看到提升度，相當好，4.84。

cues.en: I remind that all our rules here will have lift larger than three. And then where is the support?
cues.zh: 提醒一下，這裡所有規則的提升度都大於 3。支持度在哪裡？

cues.en: The support is right here.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: The support is 0.0045, meaning that the rule containing these two products appears in 0.45% of the transactions.
cues.zh: 支持度是 0.0045，表示包含這兩項產品的規則，出現在 0.45% 的交易中。

cues.en: Alright, then let's see what we have, so the second one, escalope mushroom cream sauce, but same, the items base is mushroom cream sauce, and the items add is escalope,
cues.zh: 再看第二個，薄肉排和蘑菇奶油醬；一樣，items_base 是 mushroom cream sauce，items_add 是 escalope，

cues.en: meaning that if customers buy mushroom cream sauce, then they will have a high chance of buying escalope, and that high chance is 30%.
cues.zh: 表示買蘑菇奶油醬的顧客，很可能買薄肉排，這個機率是 30%。

cues.en: Right? 30%.
Then the lift is 3.79, 3.8, and the support is 0.005.
Okay, good.
cues.zh: 好，很好。

cues.en: So you see you have all these rules, they look great, but we would actually appreciate a nicer way to have a look at them because here you see we have to do these scrolls to the right and left,
cues.zh: 這些規則看起來很棒，但希望能更方便地查看，因為目前必須左右捲動，

cues.en: and it's a bit overwhelming, so don't worry.
cues.zh: 有點讓人吃不消，不用擔心。

cues.en: I actually found a good code snippet online, I think it was from Stack Overflow or another source like that.
cues.zh: 我在網路找到一段好用的程式碼，應該來自 Stack Overflow 或類似來源。

cues.en: So we're gonna use that code snippet to actually put the results, well organized, into a Pandas data frame.
cues.zh: 我們會用它把結果整齊地放進 pandas DataFrame。

cues.en: We won't have to reimplement that code snippet from scratch because you know, it is very specific to this association rule learning implementation, and therefore you will just see that once in your life.
cues.zh: 不會從零重新實作這段程式碼，因為它非常針對這個關聯規則學習實作，可能一生只會看這麼一次。

cues.en: So it's not essential, and therefore we'll just copy and paste it here from our original implementation.
cues.zh: 所以不是重點，直接從原始實作複製貼上。

cues.en: But of course, I will explain to you the code.
cues.zh: 當然，我會解釋程式碼。

cues.en: So let's get it first.
cues.zh: 先取得它。

cues.en: It's actually at the bottom and it is this one. Alright?
cues.zh: 它在最底下，就是這一段，好嗎？

cues.en: We make an inspect function, which will return the rules, meaning these rules are well organized into a Pandas data frame.
cues.zh: 建立 inspect 函式，會傳回規則，並將規則整理進 pandas DataFrame。

cues.en: And the cool thing about this is that we will even be able to sort the rules by a descending metric.
cues.zh: 很棒的是，甚至可以按照某個指標由高到低排序規則。

cues.en: Right? Because if we notice here, well, they're not sorted, you know.
cues.zh: 因為注意這裡，它們沒有排序。

cues.en: The lift stored at 4.84 then goes down to 3.79 and then goes back up to 4.7 and here 5.16.
cues.zh: 提升度從 4.84 降到 3.79，又升回 4.7，這裡是 5.16。

cues.en: And remember that the lift is actually the most relevant metric to measure the strength of a rule, you know?
cues.zh: 記得提升度其實是衡量規則強度最有用的指標。

cues.en: So if we want to store the rule, you know, to get the strongest one, if we want to, you know, select a few deals, well, we would rather do it with the lift.
cues.zh: 如果要排序規則、取得最強的，挑出幾個優惠，最好根據提升度。

cues.en: So what will be really nice here, you know, when putting these results into well organized Pandas data frame is that then we will be able to sort easily the rules by the lift.
cues.zh: 所以把結果整齊放進 pandas DataFrame 的好處，是之後可以輕鬆按照提升度排序規則，

cues.en: or another metric. Alright? So let's get this function.
cues.zh: 或者其他指標。好，來取得這個函式。

cues.en: I'm going to copy it here.
cues.zh: 複製這裡。

cues.en: And we will paste it inside our implementation, right here.
cues.zh: 貼到實作裡，就在這裡。

cues.en: There we go, paste, and now let me explain to you how it works. So, as we can see it is a function that takes as input, the results, meaning these results, the rules as they are right now, you know,
cues.zh: 貼上，現在解釋如何運作。可以看到，這個函式接受 results 作為輸入，也就是目前這些規則，

cues.en: organized this way.
cues.zh: 以這個方式組織。

cues.en: And then it'll take, separately, the left hand side of the rule, meaning the product at the left hand side of the rule, then the product at the right hand side of the rule,
cues.zh: 接著分別取出規則左側，也就是左側產品，再取右側產品，

cues.en: then the support of all the rules, then the confidences, the lift of these rules.
cues.zh: 然後是所有規則的支持度、信賴度與提升度。

cues.en: And then it'll return all the rules with the left hand side and the right hand side and their supports, confidences and lift inside the list, right?
cues.zh: 再把所有規則的左右兩側，以及支持度、信賴度與提升度，放進串列傳回，對吧？

cues.en: That's why we have this list function here again, alright?
cues.zh: 所以這裡再次使用 list 函式，好嗎？

cues.en: So that's what this 'inspect' function will do.
cues.zh: 這就是 inspect 函式的工作。

cues.en: And then at the end, we create the final Pandas data frame, which takes as input the output of this inspect function.
cues.zh: 最後建立最終的 pandas DataFrame，輸入是 inspect 函式的輸出。

cues.en: And besides we add the column names, you know, the first column will be the left hand side of the rule.
cues.zh: 另外加上欄名，第一欄是規則左側。

cues.en: The second column will be the right hand side of the rule.
cues.zh: 第二欄是規則右側。

cues.en: The third column will be the support, force, the confidence, and finally the lift. So we will have a super nice table.
cues.zh: 第三欄是支持度，第四欄是信賴度，最後是提升度。會得到非常漂亮的表格，

cues.en: With these columns and giving all the important information for each of the rules. Okay?
cues.zh: 透過這些欄，提供每條規則的所有重要資訊，好嗎？

cues.en: So that will be super practical.
cues.zh: 所以會非常實用。

cues.en: And now let me explain how, you know, we get each of these elements, you know, the left hand side and then the right hand side.
cues.zh: 現在說明怎麼取得各個元素，也就是左側與右側。

cues.en: Alright, so the first thing to notice is that full loop inside a single row.
cues.zh: 首先注意這個單行 for 迴圈。

cues.en: Indeed, we take the full list of all the rules here, you know, that's the full list of results.
cues.zh: 這裡取出完整規則串列，也就是完整的 results 串列。

cues.en: And then for each of the rule in this full list of rules, well, we're gonna access each of these elements and take them separately.
cues.zh: 對完整串列中的每條規則，分別存取各個元素，把它們取出。

cues.en: And so let's start with left hand side.
cues.zh: 先從左側開始。

cues.en: How do we take that left hand side, which is, you know, right here.
cues.zh: 怎麼取得左側，也就是這裡？

cues.en: The items base frozen set light cream, basically light cream.
cues.zh: items_base、frozenset、light cream，基本上就是低脂鮮奶油。

cues.en: Well, let's see.
cues.zh: 來看看。

cues.en: So first we take the single rule, you know, let's take for example this one to explain how we're gonna get these elements. So we take these rules, and then in this rule, we first access the index two.
cues.zh: 先取出單一規則，例如用這條說明如何取得元素。取這條規則後，先存取索引 2。

cues.en: Alright? So let's access it step by step.
cues.zh: 一步一步來。

cues.en: This element here, you know, up to the comma, is the elements of index zero, okay?
cues.zh: 這裡直到逗號的這個元素，是索引 0，好嗎？

cues.en: Then, this element is the element of index one.
cues.zh: 接著這個是索引 1。

cues.en: This is the second element, and then this full element, you know, up to the closing square brackets here, is actually the element of index two. Alright?
cues.zh: 這是第二個元素，再來這整段直到右方括號，其實就是索引 2 的元素。

cues.en: So all I've highlighted here is the element of index two.
cues.zh: 現在反白的全部，就是索引 2 的元素。

cues.en: So now in that element of index two, then we're gonna access the element of index zero, meaning the first element, and the first element is actually the first element of that
cues.zh: 接著在索引 2 裡存取索引 0，也就是第一個元素；它其實是這個

cues.en: list, you know, in square brackets.
cues.zh: 方括號串列中的第一個元素。

cues.en: And that is of course all this, you know, ordered statistic up to, be careful, you know, up to the closing parenthesis here, meaning right here.
cues.zh: 當然是這整段 OrderedStatistic，直到這裡的右括號，注意，是這裡。

cues.en: So all this is the first element inside that, you know, big element, which I've just highlighted before, you know,
cues.zh: 這整段就是剛才反白的大元素中的第一個元素，

cues.en: from ordered statistics up to, actually, the end. Alright?
cues.zh: 從 OrderedStatistic 一直到結尾，好嗎？

cues.en: So this is the element of index zero, and then in this new element of index zero, we're gonna access the first element, you know, of index zero again, and well,
cues.zh: 這是索引 0；再進入這個新元素，取得第一個元素，也就是再次存取索引 0，

cues.en: you know, we have to look inside this parenthesis, and that's of course this element, which is indeed the left hand side, right?
cues.zh: 要看這對括號裡，當然就是這個元素，也就是左側，對吧？

cues.en: Because this is what we want to get.
cues.zh: 因為這正是想取得的。

cues.en: Left hand side items base, that's the same, and that is light cream.
cues.zh: 左側就是 items_base，也就是 light cream。

cues.en: And then for the right hand side, that's the same, you know, we took the same first element of index two, then that whole element of index zero inside this first
cues.zh: 右側也是一樣，先取索引 2，再取其中整個索引 0 的元素，

cues.en: element of index two, and then, instead of taking the index zero here, we take the index one, which is that element items add frozen set chicken,
cues.zh: 但這次不取索引 0，而是索引 1，也就是 items_add、frozenset、chicken 這個元素。

cues.en: alright? So that element is, you know, that element of index two, then index zero, then index one, and then that index is to indeed catch what's inside, you know, chicken.
cues.zh: 所以路徑是索引 2、索引 0、索引 1，最後這個索引用來取出裡面的 chicken。

cues.en: And same for that index zero here, that was to catch light cream. Alright?
cues.zh: 這裡最後的索引 0，也同樣是用來取出 light cream，好嗎？

cues.en: So you see we just play with the indexes to access what we want, but really you will only have to do that once in your life.
cues.zh: 所以只是運用索引存取需要的內容，但這件事其實一生只需要做一次。

cues.en: So don't worry too much about this kind of overwhelming code, even if it's quite funny to, you know, follow the indexes path to find the products.
cues.zh: 不用太擔心這段有點複雜的程式碼，雖然沿著索引路徑找產品還滿有趣。

cues.en: But then the good news is that for the support, it's gonna be much simpler. Indeed.
cues.zh: 好消息是，支持度簡單得多。

cues.en: We just need to take the full rule, you know, the single rule, so, you know, this whole rule.
cues.zh: 只要取完整的單一規則，也就是這整條，

cues.en: And then very simply, we access the element of index one directly.
cues.zh: 再直接存取索引 1 的元素。

cues.en: So remember, in this full single rule, well, all this is the element of index zero, and then all this is the element of index one,
cues.zh: 記得，在這條完整規則裡，這一整段是索引 0，再來這段是索引 1，

cues.en: and that's exactly the support, which is what we want.
cues.zh: 正好就是支持度，也就是我們要的。

cues.en: And we do this for each of the rules in this whole list of rules. Okay?
cues.zh: 對整個規則串列裡的每條規則都這樣做，好嗎？

cues.en: Then confidences, once again, it's a bit more complicated, but just like before, first we get the element of index two.
cues.zh: 信賴度又稍微複雜些，但和剛才一樣，先取索引 2 的元素。

cues.zh: 再看一次，這是索引 0，

cues.zh: 這是索引 1，這整段是索引 2，好嗎？

cues.zh: 從這裡的 OrderedStatistic 開始，到它的右括號，應該在這裡，對吧？

cues.zh: 檢查一下括號。

cues.en: So that's the first opening one.
cues.zh: 這是第一個左括號。

cues.en: Then the second opening one, closing here.
cues.zh: 第二個左括號，在這裡結束。

cues.en: Then this is a new opening one, closing here, and then there you go.
cues.zh: 接著新的左括號，在這裡結束，好了。

cues.en: Okay, so that's the closing prothesis of indeed, this element of index two, then index zero, and then inside this element, now we're gonna get access to the element of index two.
cues.zh: 這就是索引 2、再索引 0 這個元素的右括號；接著進到元素裡，存取索引 2。

cues.en: So that's the element of index zero.
cues.zh: 這是索引 0，

cues.zh: 這是索引 1，最後這是索引 2，正好是信賴度，也就是現在要取出的。

cues.en: And then same for the lift. So same path.
cues.zh: 提升度也一樣，走相同路徑。

cues.en: First we get access to the index two, then index zero.
cues.zh: 先存取索引 2，再索引 0。

cues.en: So just like we were right now.
cues.zh: 就和剛才一樣。

cues.zh: 但不是像信賴度取索引 2，而是下一個索引 3，當然對應提升度，好嗎？
